tiers.name: No Activation Checkpointing (Store All Layer Activations in HBM)
tiers.note: Storing all 80 layers of SwiGLU + Norm + Attention activations demands 68.0 GB/GPU (+18GB weights/states = 86GB > 80GB) -> Instant OOM!

tiers.name: Full-Layer Activation Checkpointing (Recompute All GEMMs & Attention in Backward)
tiers.note: Shrinks activations to 5.2 GB (only layer boundaries), but re-executes 100% of forward GEMMs & FlashAttention (+33.3% FLOPs tax -> 395 effective TFLOPS)!

tiers.name: Legacy Attention-Only Recompute (Still Stores Huge SwiGLU & Norm Activations)
tiers.note: FlashAttention already stores only O(N) LSE + output, while un-checkpointed SwiGLU (gate + up projections) + RMSNorm still eat 44.5 GB!

tiers.name: Op-Level SAC (MUST_SAVE Expensive GEMM/FA Outputs, Recompute SwiGLU/Norm/RoPE + 50% MM)
tiers.note: Saves expensive aten.mm / flash_attn outputs and recomputes memory-heavy elementwise SwiGLU/RMSNorm/RoPE -> 18.7 GB (-72.5%) at only +2.4% FLOPs (514 TFLOPS, 1.30x)!
